description: This Java class defines an Android Service named SecureWebServerService that manages the lifecycle of a SecureWebServer instance. It starts the server in onCreate(), stops it in onDestroy(), and creates a persistent notification to indicate the service is running. The class interacts with Android framework components such as Notifications, Intents, and Service lifecycle methods.

classes.name: SecureWebServerService
classes.description: An Android Service managing a SecureWebServer instance, handling its startup, shutdown, and user notification procedures.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, starts the SSL web server, and creates an ongoing notification.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops the SSL web server and removes the ongoing notification when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not supported for this service.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Creates and posts a persistent notification that allows the user to stop the server by clicking it.
